scope: Native admission of SemanticProgram envelope source identity, core literal fields (schemaVersion/language/units/requiredFeatures/identityVersion/schema), declared capabilities and the exact derived capability closure
coverage: Source descriptor admitted natively: exact keys, lowercase SHA-256 digest, UTF-8 byte length 0..4000000 and UTF-16 code-unit length 0..250000, including boundary values

Core literals admitted natively: semantic-program-core schema, semantic-program-core-v1 identity, exactly semantic.execution-v2 required feature, semantic-capabilities-v1 capability graph and the fixed units/frame/matrix sextet
Schema versions 1.0 and 1.1 refuse with the relowering-style message; other versions refuse as unsupported
Both language contracts admitted natively with their pinned semantics revisions (legacy/current 1.0.0, openscad-viewer/brep-1 brep-1.0.0); cross-pinned revisions refuse

deriveSemanticCapabilityClosure ported exactly to Rust: per-kind capabilities, geometry kind/space/representation/evidence entries, certified-approximation profile/policy entries, Boolean operation entries, geometry/representation/evidence transitions, semantic.program-v1 and semantic.result.<tag>, with dedup and raw UTF-8 byte sort
A multi-node program (box + transform + Boolean union) derives the closure string-for-string, as does a 2D-to-3D extrusion crossing a geometry transition
Declared capabilities (limit 32) and capability closure (limit 128) refuse when unsorted, duplicated, malformed or oversized; every wrong-by-one closure variant refuses
Admission is optional-but-strict: requests without envelope components execute unchanged, and every refusal happens before any graph node executes (zero completed nodes, no partial outputs)

executeBrepNativeProgram now transports source, schemaVersion, language, units, requiredFeatures, identityVersion, schema, declaredCapabilities, capabilityClosure and diagnosticTemplates through graph-begin; tampered programs are refused natively with E_BREP_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT
behaviorChange: The graph/session admission path now validates envelope components carried on the request before any node executes; requests carrying tampered or inconsistent source, literal or capability components fail with BREP_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT instead of executing geometry.
limitations: Occurrence-ID digest hashing (occv1:/entity:v2:) is not yet recomputed natively; occurrence rows are admitted structurally only
Operations structural identity (opv1: digests, structural paths, ambiguity groups) remains host-validated only
Provenance, tessellationIntents and diagnostics admission remain host-side; only the diagnostic template count enters the native closure derivation
The full envelope (envelope schema/version, exact core key set) is not admitted as one object natively; components arrive as graph-begin fields
The application executor replacement and full SemanticProgram admission remain open
